title: Ousted PM Sheikh Hasina plans Bangladesh return: 'I may be killed, I may be sent to prison'
summary_full: Ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh by December. She is prepared to face arrest, imprisonment, or even execution upon her arrival. Hasina fled the country in August 2024 after widespread protests ended her rule. Her party faces repression and legal proceedings following the change in government.
